name: Squared Away + Bodycam 0.3
body:
Squared Away + Bodycam 0.3, based on the October 16 Bodycam release. Includes the new camera, weapon handling and scope improvements with Squared Away inventory support.

- **DX11-AVX only.** Install both `bin` and `db/mods` from the engine ZIP.
- **GAMMA:** also install Bodycam GAMMA Patch 1.1.0. Follow its included instructions, replace the older PiP compatibility patches and clear the shader cache.
- Keep your Squared Away mod. Standard-engine users do not need this update.

Uses the original Bodycam camera pivot; the experimental pivot changes are not included.

[Downloads and installation](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads)

name: Squared Away — Engine Update 2026.10.11
body:
Updates both Squared Away engines to mrdemonized’s **2026.10.11** release, including upstream rendering, weapon and scripting fixes.

- **All DX:** standard engine, all eight renderer variants.
- **Bodycam:** optional combined engine, DX11-AVX only.

Keep **Squared Away 2.0.6 Hotfix 4**. Back up your current engine files, then install **both `bin` and `db/mods`** from your chosen ZIP into Anomaly. No new game is required.

Saving and changing areas were tested with bolts in a rig and items in boxes. **There may still be issues I didn’t catch. If anything is wrong, please report it in the [Discord thread](https://discord.com/channels/912320241713958912/1542887991222206484) and go back to the matching standard or Bodycam engine from the [2.0.3 post](https://github.com/Fomok/xray-monolith-inventory-edits/releases/tag/v2.0.3). Restore both its `bin` and `db/mods` files.**

[Downloads and installation](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads) · [Upstream changes](https://github.com/themrdemonized/xray-monolith/releases/tag/2026.10.11)

name: Squared Away 2.1.0 Minor Update
body:

- Artifacts Bag
- Small Artifact Bag
- Tall Mag Pouch — adds one tall magazine slot
- Advanced Tall Mag Pouch — adds two tall magazine slots

### Texture edits

- Patrontash
- Razvedka Sling
- Hip Pouch
- Pistol Case
- Field Medical Case

### Texture repositions

- Barakholka Rig
- 6Sh92 Surplus Rig
- Tarzan-M22

[Downloads and installation](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads)

name: Squared Away 2.0.6 - hotfix 4
body:
Fixes the save crash caused by bolts stored in rig pockets, including a single bolt. Bolt counts and pocket placement are preserved when loading.

Install the full ZIP with your usual compatibility options. Disable the separate **Bolt Rig Save Test 1** patch if installed. Includes all earlier 2.0.6 hotfixes.

**No new game or engine update required.** Keep the standard or Bodycam 2.0.3 engine.

[Downloads and installation](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads)

name: Squared Away 2.0.6 - hotfix 3
body:
Fixes stretched backgrounds and misaligned inventory controls in ZONA on ultrawide screens. Included in **SOTA UI Compatibility (ZONA)**. Default UI, GAMMA compatibility and 16:9 layouts are unchanged.

Install the full ZIP and select your usual patches. Disable **ZONA Ultrawide Test 1** if installed. Includes both earlier stats hotfixes.

**No new game or engine update needed.** Keep the standard or Bodycam 2.0.3 engine.

[Downloads and installation](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads)

name: Squared Away 2.0.6 - hotfix 2
body:
Sry i forgot about that funcionality xD

Hovering over items now previews stat gains in white and losses in red, while keeping the current fill visible. Percentages show current and predicted values. Includes the previous expanded-stack fix.

![Item effect preview](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/assets/patch-notes/stats-effects-hotfix2.png)

Install the full ZIP with your usual patches. Disable the separate stats preview/stack test patches. **No new game or engine update needed.** Keep the standard or Bodycam 2.0.3 engine.

[Downloads and installation](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads)

name: Squared Away 2.0.6 - hotfix
body:
Fixes expanded item stacks displaying over the new stats bars. The bars and their tooltips now hide while a stack is open and return when it closes.

Download the full mod ZIP and choose your usual compatibility patches. Disable the separate Stats Stack Fix Test patch if installed. **No new game, engine update or add-on redownload needed.** Keep your standard or Bodycam 2.0.3 engine.

[Installation and downloads](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/#downloads)

name: Squared Away 2.0.6 - Clearer inventory stats
body:
Optional new inventory stats with slim coloured bars, full names and a roomier layout. Supports default UI and GAMMA/ZONA SOTA, including vertical weapons.

Enabled by default; turn off **Use Squared Away slim stats bars** in **MCM > Squared Away > Appearance** to restore the original UI. This is a small visual update; you can skip it if you prefer your current layout.

![New stats panel](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/assets/patch-notes/stats-2.0.6.png)

Replace the full mod ZIP, select your usual patches and disable separate stats test mods. **Keep the 2.0.3 engine. Existing 2.0.x saves work.**

name: Squared Away 2.0.5 - SOTA UI FIX + ZONA modpack compatibility patch
body:
Fixes the SOTA UI vertical weapon-slot crash and adds separate ZONA SOTA UI and Magazines Redux compatibility options.

**ZONA recipes, repair parts, dismantling returns and trader settings may be wrong or not work. Squared Away was built for GAMMA; these may need modpack-specific adaptation.** ZoneBench now supports manual recipe and repair item IDs.

Replace the mod with the **2.0.5 ZIP**, select your matching compatibility options, and disable separate test fixes. Existing 2.0.x saves work. **Keep the 2.0.3 engine — no new engine download is needed.**

name: Squared Away - 2.0.4 & ZoneBench Update
body:
Independent ZoneBench add-ons can now be installed together, each with its own item IDs, textures and configuration files. Includes the redesigned ZoneBench editor, guided item creation and searchable crafting, repair and dismantling parts.

name: Squared Away - 2.0.3 Ammo Hotfix
body:
Fixes loose ammunition being consumed and recreated when reloading magazine-fed weapons, including the early-reload interaction with Dynamic Reload Speeds.

Install the **2.0.3 mod and matching engine**, then select the optional **Mags Reloaded ammo fix** in FOMOD. Requires Mags Reloaded Fork by Priler UPDATE 6 and its Dynamic Reload Speeds dependency. Let Squared Away win their file conflicts in MO2.

Existing 2.0.x saves work. Normal loose-ammo weapons, grenade launchers and magazine loading retain their usual behavior.

- **2.0.3.zip** — full mod with installer.
- **Engine - All DX.zip** — standard engine and matching DB0.
- **Engine - Bodycam.zip** — alternative for Bodycam users, DX11-AVX only.
- **For Developers.zip** — engine merge sources and diff.

[Downloads, installation guide and patch-note history](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/)

name: Squared Away - 2.0.2
body:
Equip weapons straight from dead bodies, even with a full backpack. Weapon swaps return the replaced weapon to the body. Works without the optional looting patch.

The optional Tarkov-like looting layout now has Field Kit equipment slots, a Pockets divider and remembered item positions and rotations.

**Install both the 2.0.2 mod and matching engine (including DB0). Existing 2.0 / 2.0.1 saves work; no new game needed.**

- **2.0.2.zip** — full mod with installer.
- **Engine - All DX.zip** — required engine, all eight DX/AVX variants.
- **Engine - Bodycam.zip** — optional combined engine for Bodycam users, DX11-AVX only. Use instead of the standard engine; install both bin and db/mods from this ZIP.
- **For Developers.zip** — merge files and full engine diff; not needed to play.

Upgrading from a version before 2.0 requires a new game.

[Installation guide, editor and patch notes](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/)

**Optional Bodycam engine — October 5, 2026**
Based on [Bodycam 2026.8.4](https://github.com/asuparabekon/xray-monolith-bodycam/releases/tag/2026.8.4-bodycam-mt), combined with Squared Away 2.0.2. Keep the 2.0.2 mod installed. For PiP scopes, follow Bodycam’s requirements for the matching external 3DSS PiP patch. Standard-engine users do not need this download.

name: Squared Away - 2.0 Update (Hotfix 2.0.1)
body:
A rebuilt inventory with saved layouts, persistent containers, dedicated rig storage and direct item transfers.

**Latest: 2.0.1 localization hotfix — October 4, 2026**
- Updated English descriptions and settings.
- Completed Russian, Spanish and Ukrainian text, including gameplay messages and optional patches.
- Fixed missing translations and unreadable text.

Already using 2.0? Replace the mod in MO2 and choose the same optional patches. Keep your engine and saves.

**Downloads**
- **Update.zip** — full mod with installer, including the hotfix.
- **Engine - All DX.zip** — required custom engine and DB0.
- **For Developers.zip** — engine merge files and diff.

Upgrading from a version before 2.0 requires a new game.

[Installation guide, editor and full patch-note history](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/)
